name: How do I choose the right contractor for interior storm damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for interior storm damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who provides on-site oversight, clear estimates, solid trade credentials, and comprehensive finishing capabilities. Storm repair is sensitive to delays; choosing an owner-operated or hands-on contractor means the person estimating the work often leads or directly oversees the demo, sheetrock hanging, and paint blending. Check that the company holds an A+ BBB accreditation, carries proper liability insurance, and offers finish carpentry skills so baseboards, moldings, and room transitions look original once the drywall is finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select an established, BBB-accredited contractor with hands-on site supervision who handles framing, drywall, trim, and paint to ensure seamless restoration.
